snippet.title: Middle-earth: Shadow Bundle – Pre-order Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
snippet.description:
Pre-order Middle-earth: Shadow of Mordor and Middle-earth: Shadow of War to receive 50% off before the game launches on September 30, 2026: https://ninten.do/6002a5CAn

Experience the Middle-earth saga and the Nemesis System now on Nintendo Switch 2! Go behind enemy lines to forge your army, conquer Fortresses and dominate Mordor from within. 

#Middleearth #ShadowofMordor #ShadowofWar 

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s

Subscribe for more Nintendo fun: https://goo.gl/HYYsot
